# Copilot Instructions

This repository is a single fully static Vue 3 + Vite portfolio.

- Use Vue directly; do not introduce Nuxt, React/Next, Tailwind, or a UI framework without an explicit architecture change.
- Use SCSS for styling.
- Keep portfolio content repository-local and build-time generated.
- Production output is `dist/` from the custom Vite prerender build; there is no backend/runtime API/SSR server.
- Follow root `AGENTS.md` for validation, Git, and concurrent-worktree rules.
